definitions: A peninsula and urban area in Hong Kong, China, forming the northern part of Victoria Harbour.
A former walled city in Hong Kong, known for its high population density and lack of government oversight, which was demolished in the 1990s.
examples: We took the ferry to Kowloon.
The view of Hong Kong Island from Kowloon is stunning.
The Kowloon Walled City was a unique urban phenomenon.
